criteria.statement: Prompt tests for both modes assert the specified section orders
No separate rulings section; rulings follow their card once, at first appearance
In-Depth topic tests: title and section-title words trigger a topic, zone alone does not; Quick Lookup keeps four always-on topics plus REQ-220
In-Depth keeps at least 17 of 30 deciding rules on the 9 shared corpus cases
Instruction tests: one list, one stack numbering, no reference to an absent section in either mode
Card-block tests cover power, toughness, loyalty, multi-face joining and line breaks; contract tests prove card-detail route and frontend payload unchanged
Slots REQ-241, 242, 243, 245, 030, 074, 176, 220, FLOW-011, FLOW-023 and five section docs applied by intent
Each golden prompt change is reviewed and listed in the evidence log
